Name: Total Sales
Description: Net invoiced amount after line discount.

Name: Customer Count
Description: Customers with at least one line.

Name: Gross Margin %
Description: Margin as a share of net sales. Certified figure used in the board pack.

Name: Sales YoY %
Description: Growth against the same period last year.

Name: Avg Category Margin %
Description: Mean of the per-category margin, not the overall margin.

Name: Discount Impact
Description: Share of list value given away as line discount.
Expression:
VAR _gross =
    SUMX ( Sales, Sales[Quantity] * Sales[UnitPrice] )
VAR _net = [Total Sales]
RETURN
    DIVIDE ( _gross - _net, _gross )

Name: _Base Sales Helper
Description: Internal helper, hidden from report authors.
